# University of Rhode Island

> > The University of Rhode Island provides comprehensive information on admissions, academic support, student life, and global learning opportunities for undergraduate and graduate students.

URI is a major research institution offering detailed resources for prospective and current students, including international admissions, residential life, career services, and diversity initiatives. The site emphasizes experiential learning, inclusive excellence, and student success through academic advising and professional development.

## Key Topics

- International Admission
- Undergraduate Requirements
- Graduate Programs
- Application Process
- English Proficiency (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo)
- Standardized Tests (SAT, ACT)
- Diversity and Inclusion
- Student Resources
- Experiential Learning
- Career Services
- Residential Life
- Academic Advising
- Study Abroad
- Transfer Students
- Merit Scholarships

## Admissions

- [International Admission – Undergraduate Admission](https://web.uri.edu/admission/international-admission-requirements): International student admission requirements, application process, and deadlines

## Graduate Education

- [Graduate School](https://web.uri.edu/graduate-school): Graduate programs, admissions, research opportunities, and student support

## Academic Support & Success

- [Academic Advising – Fannon Institute for Student Success](https://web.uri.edu/advising): Academic advising, degree planning, and student success resources at FISS
- [University Libraries](https://web.uri.edu/library): Library search, research resources, databases, and study spaces at URI
- [Students – Center for Career and Experiential Education](https://web.uri.edu/career/students): Career preparation, internships, resume review, and professional development

## Student Life & Community

- [Housing and Residential Life](https://web.uri.edu/housing): Student housing, residential communities, and campus living information
- [Dining Services – We Feed URI!](https://web.uri.edu/dining): Campus dining services, meal plans, and nutrition information for students
- [Community, Equity and Diversity](https://web.uri.edu/diversity): URI's diversity initiatives, inclusive excellence, and community building programs

## Global Engagement

- [URI in the World](https://web.uri.edu/global): Global initiatives, study abroad, and international learning opportunities at URI

## Optional

- [Public Records](https://web.uri.edu/publicrecords): Public records access and APRA compliance information for URI
- [Web Accessibility](https://web.uri.edu/accessibility): Web accessibility standards, ADA compliance, and inclusive design policies
